highlights: Result Update 05th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,255 Mahanagar Gas Ltd Oil & Gas 1 Margin Compression on Higher Gas Costs; Volume Momentum Intact Est.

The QoQ decline was driven by (i) a 5% QoQ contraction in gross spread to Rs 13.77/scm, as the 3% rise in realisation to Rs 56.11/scm failed to offset higher gas costs, with FO/LDO-linked industrial prices falling 6–15% QoQ, and (ii) elevated opex from volume-linked costs and a one-off Rs 10–12 Cr employee cost, adjusting for which EBITDA/scm stood at ~Rs 7.0/scm.
Small commercial volumes grew ~9–12% YoY, and management highlighted that contracted daily offtake has increased, positioning I&C for a double-digit rebound once supply normalises.

Management reiterated 8–9%+ volume growth for FY27/FY28, contingent on supply normalisation. • Sourcing Shifting Toward Domestic Gas; HPHT Allocation a Key Cost Lever: D-PNG remains 100% APM-sourced, I&C is fully met through RLNG (largely HH-linked term contracts with a small Brent-linked portion), and ~60% of CNG is met through domestic gas (APM, NWG and HPHT).
valuation: Result Update 05th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 1,255 Mahanagar Gas Ltd Oil & Gas 1 Margin Compression on Higher Gas Costs; Volume Momentum Intact Est.
Current Valuation: DCF Basis (Unchanged) Current TP: Rs 1,255/share (Earlier TP: Rs 1,300/share) Recommendation: We maintain our BUY recommendation on the stock.
We add net cash and investments at a 30% discount to arrive at our target price of Rs 1,255/share (Earlier TP: Rs 1,300/share), which reflects an upside of 18% from the CMP.
watch: Management reiterated 8–9%+ volume growth for FY27/FY28, contingent on supply normalisation. • Sourcing Shifting Toward Domestic Gas; HPHT Allocation a Key Cost Lever: D-PNG remains 100% APM-sourced, I&C is fully met through RLNG (largely HH-linked term contracts with a small Brent-linked portion), and ~60% of CNG is met through domestic gas (APM, NWG and HPHT).

MGL has also tied up ~40,000 MMBTU of new term LNG, which is already flowing, and partially hedged winter exposure by converting index-based contracts to fixed pricing. • Sector Outlook: Cautiously Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: MGL remains on track for volume growth, even as near-term margins stay hostage to the West Asia crisis and elevated RLNG costs.
